items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I think I heard a follow up or something about Woody Herman getting back to him, something in the Bill Crow book.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. You remember the famous baritone player Serge Chaloff, he played with Woody Herman. Well Serge was a wonderful baritone player but he memorized the whole book. But he had a habit of coming to work late or coming back after the intermission too late, and Woody was getting sick of it, and told him next time you’re going to get fired, next time you’re late. And Serge showed up late and Woody fired him right there, or gave him his two weeks’ notice. So the bus was traveling you know. And so they were…
That was nasty. I think I heard a follow up or something about Woody Herman getting back to him, something in the Bill Crow book. Pretty nasty actually.
